slot.brief: 4 short sentences (PQRS) on a simple, familiar topic (e.g., daily habit or a well-known fact) with an obvious chronological or pronoun link; ask for the correct PQRS order.

stem:
Arrange the parts P, Q, R and S to form a meaningful sequence.

Maya planted a seed in a pot.

P: After a few days, it began to sprout.
Q: In time, it grew into a young plant.
R: She placed the pot near a sunny window.
S: She watered it every morning.

Which is the correct sequence?

verdicts.working: Place the pot near sunlight and water it before it sprouts; afterward, it grows into a young plant: R–S–P–Q.
issues: The timing of placing the pot in sunlight and watering it is not explicit, though A is the only option with both actions before sprouting.

working:
The pot is first placed by the window (R), then watered regularly (S). The seed sprouts (P) and later grows into a young plant (Q).

Independent check: Place the pot near sunlight and water it before it sprouts; afterward, it grows into a young plant: R–S–P–Q.
